snippet.title: Kosenki | New Official Trailer - Premiered at @LAGShowcase  @latamgamescom  ⚔️⛩️
snippet.description:
New trailer is here! ⚔️⛩️ Premiered at @LAGShowcase @gamescomlatam.
Discover the world of KOSENKI, a fast-paced, stylish combat game set in a dark techno-feudal world. Master creative, high-speed battles as Hayato, a broken samurai fighting enemies from a Kosenki-corrupted world, and his own inner demons.
The battle is within 👁️
